official_name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan Yojana
objective: Old age protection for unorganised workers by providing assured monthly pension of Rs 3000 after age 60.
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers. Monthly contribution ranges from Rs 55 to Rs 200 depending upon the entry age. 50% paid by beneficiary and 50% matched by Central Government.
